quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: Subordinate phrase 'Insofar as' qualifies an unusually strong claim of neutrality.
quests.explanation: Insofar as any philosophical position can claim genuine neutrality (qualifying phrase) + this one comes closer than most to that elusive ideal (main clause). The qualifier acknowledges that complete neutrality may be philosophically impossible.
quests.textToSpeak: Insofar as any philosophical position can claim genuine neutrality, this one comes closer than most to that elusive ideal.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: Formal inverted conditional describing a Hegelian philosophical process.
quests.explanation: Were one to accept the dialectical method without reservation (formal inverted conditional) + the resulting synthesis would necessarily transcend both original positions (hypothetical result). 'Transcend' means to go beyond the limitations of something.
quests.textToSpeak: Were one to accept the dialectical method without reservation, the resulting synthesis would necessarily transcend both original positions.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: Inverted concessive clause 'troubling though it has proven'.
quests.explanation: Subject (The paradox) + troubling though it has proven for centuries of philosophers (inverted concessive clause) + may ultimately admit no satisfactory resolution (main verb). Some philosophical paradoxes may be inherently unresolvable.
quests.textToSpeak: The paradox, troubling though it has proven for centuries of philosophers, may ultimately admit no satisfactory resolution.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: Formal subordinate phrase 'Notwithstanding' contrasts ingenuity with persistent difficulty.
quests.explanation: Notwithstanding the considerable ingenuity of the proposed solution (formal contrast phrase) + the underlying metaphysical puzzle remains entirely untouched (main clause). 'Metaphysical' relates to the fundamental nature of reality and existence.
quests.textToSpeak: Notwithstanding the considerable ingenuity of the proposed solution, the underlying metaphysical puzzle remains entirely untouched.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: Fronted phrase 'Far from dissolving' with embedded comparative clause.
quests.explanation: Far from dissolving the question, as some have claimed (fronted contrast phrase with embedded clause) + this reformulation merely relocates the original difficulty (main clause). The embedded clause acknowledges a rival interpretation before rejecting it.
quests.textToSpeak: Far from dissolving the question, as some have claimed, this reformulation merely relocates the original difficulty.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: Subordinate clause 'Much as' introduces strong concession against hasty dismissal.
quests.explanation: Much as one might be tempted to dismiss the skeptic's challenge outright (strong concession) + doing so prematurely forecloses serious inquiry (main clause). 'Foreclose' means to prevent something from happening or being considered.
quests.textToSpeak: Much as one might be tempted to dismiss the skeptic's challenge outright, doing so prematurely forecloses serious inquiry.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: Subordinate clause 'Provided' introduces a condition with an embedded concessive aside.
quests.explanation: Provided the argument's premises are granted, even reluctantly (condition with embedded aside) + the conclusion follows with near-mathematical certainty (main clause). The embedded phrase acknowledges resistance while affirming logical necessity.
quests.textToSpeak: Provided the argument's premises are granted, even reluctantly, the conclusion follows with near-mathematical certainty.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: Subordinate clause 'Whatever' introduces unconditional concession before a lasting empirical observation.
quests.explanation: Whatever one ultimately concludes about free will (unconditional concession) + the phenomenology of choice remains a stubbornly persistent feature of experience (main clause). 'Phenomenology' refers to the structure of subjective experience itself.
quests.textToSpeak: Whatever one ultimately concludes about free will, the phenomenology of choice remains a stubbornly persistent feature of experience.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: Fronted phrase 'Short of' introduces an extreme, costly exception.
quests.explanation: Short of abandoning the correspondence theory altogether (extreme exception) + philosophers have struggled to articulate a fully coherent alternative (main clause). The correspondence theory holds that truth corresponds to facts about reality.
quests.textToSpeak: Short of abandoning the correspondence theory altogether, philosophers have struggled to articulate a fully coherent alternative.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: Inverted concessive clause 'ingenious as it undoubtedly is'.
quests.explanation: Subject (The thought experiment) + ingenious as it undoubtedly is (inverted concessive clause) + ultimately trades on an equivocation between two senses of identity (main verb). 'Trade on an equivocation' means to exploit an ambiguity in meaning.
quests.textToSpeak: The thought experiment, ingenious as it undoubtedly is, ultimately trades on an equivocation between two senses of identity.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: Subordinate phrase 'In as much as' qualifies the strength of an analogical argument.
quests.explanation: In as much as any argument from analogy can be conclusive (qualifying phrase) + this one comes unusually close to that threshold (main clause). Arguments from analogy are inherently weaker than deductive proofs.
quests.textToSpeak: In as much as any argument from analogy can be conclusive, this one comes unusually close to that threshold.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: Inverted third conditional reflecting on the consequences of imprecise terminology.
quests.explanation: Had the original distinction been drawn more carefully (inverted third conditional) + much of the subsequent confusion might plausibly have been avoided (hypothetical result). Imprecise conceptual distinctions often generate decades of unnecessary philosophical confusion.
quests.textToSpeak: Had the original distinction been drawn more carefully, much of the subsequent confusion might plausibly have been avoided.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: Subordinate phrase 'To the extent that' qualifies the epistemic status of intuition.
quests.explanation: To the extent that intuition can serve as evidence (qualifying phrase) + this case provides a particularly compelling instance of that role (main clause). Whether intuitions count as genuine evidence remains contested in epistemology.
quests.textToSpeak: To the extent that intuition can serve as evidence, this case provides a particularly compelling instance of that role.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: Inverted concessive 'however forceful it may initially seem' embedded mid-sentence.
quests.explanation: Subject (The objection) + however forceful it may initially seem (inverted concessive phrase) + ultimately conflates two importantly distinct philosophical questions (main verb). Conflating distinct questions is a common source of philosophical error.
quests.textToSpeak: The objection, however forceful it may initially seem, ultimately conflates two importantly distinct philosophical questions.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: Formal inverted conditional with sweeping epistemological stakes.
quests.explanation: Were the skeptical hypothesis genuinely irrefutable (formal inverted conditional) + the entire edifice of empirical knowledge would collapse into radical uncertainty (hypothetical result). 'Edifice' is a metaphor for a complex, structured system of belief.
quests.textToSpeak: Were the skeptical hypothesis genuinely irrefutable, the entire edifice of empirical knowledge would collapse into radical uncertainty.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: Formal subordinate phrase 'Notwithstanding' contrasts appeal with problematic implications.
quests.explanation: Notwithstanding its undeniable intuitive appeal (formal contrast phrase) + the principle generates deeply counterintuitive consequences in certain edge cases (main clause). 'Edge cases' refers to unusual situations that test the limits of a general rule.
quests.textToSpeak: Notwithstanding its undeniable intuitive appeal, the principle generates deeply counterintuitive consequences in certain edge cases.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: Fronted phrase 'Far from settling' sets up a historical philosophical contrast.
quests.explanation: Far from settling the dispute between rationalists and empiricists (fronted contrast phrase) + this finding merely reframes their centuries-old disagreement (main clause). Rationalism and empiricism represent fundamentally different theories of how knowledge is acquired.
quests.textToSpeak: Far from settling the dispute between rationalists and empiricists, this finding merely reframes their centuries-old disagreement.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: Subordinate clause 'Much as' introduces a balanced concession-critique.
quests.explanation: Much as the thought experiment illuminates certain conceptual distinctions (concession) + it arguably obscures others equally important (critique). This balanced structure shows both the value and limitation of a single analytical tool.
quests.textToSpeak: Much as the thought experiment illuminates certain conceptual distinctions, it arguably obscures others equally important.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: Subordinate clause 'Provided that' introduces a framework-dependent claim.
quests.explanation: Provided that one accepts a broadly naturalistic framework (condition) + the explanatory gap remains the single most pressing unresolved problem (main clause). The 'explanatory gap' refers to the difficulty explaining consciousness in purely physical terms.
quests.textToSpeak: Provided that one accepts a broadly naturalistic framework, the explanatory gap remains the single most pressing unresolved problem.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: Subordinate clause 'Whatever' introduces unconditional concession before a persistent philosophical puzzle.
quests.explanation: Whatever metaphysical commitments one ultimately adopts (unconditional concession) + the phenomenal character of experience resists straightforward physical reduction (main clause). 'Phenomenal character' refers to the subjective, qualitative aspect of conscious experience.
quests.textToSpeak: Whatever metaphysical commitments one ultimately adopts, the phenomenal character of experience resists straightforward physical reduction.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: Fronted phrase 'Short of' introduces a costly alternative to avoid an unresolved tension.
quests.explanation: Short of embracing an uncomfortable form of relativism (costly alternative) + it is difficult to see how this tension can be resolved (main clause). This suggests the only escape from the tension carries its own significant philosophical cost.
quests.textToSpeak: Short of embracing an uncomfortable form of relativism, it is difficult to see how this tension can be resolved.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: Inverted concessive clause 'ingenious though it is'.
quests.explanation: Subject (The counterexample) + ingenious though it is (inverted concessive clause) + ultimately depends on a controversial and contestable theory of reference (main verb). A 'theory of reference' explains how words connect to the things they denote.
quests.textToSpeak: The counterexample, ingenious though it is, ultimately depends on a controversial and contestable theory of reference.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: Subordinate phrase 'In as much as' qualifies an unusually positive claim about consensus.
quests.explanation: In as much as consensus can be achieved on contested metaphysical questions (qualifying phrase) + this remains one of the field's rare successes (main clause). Genuine philosophical consensus is historically rare and therefore notable.
quests.textToSpeak: In as much as consensus can be achieved on contested metaphysical questions, this remains one of the field's rare successes.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: Inverted third conditional reflecting on the origins of a long-running dispute.
quests.explanation: Had the conceptual framework been more precisely specified from the outset (inverted third conditional) + this protracted and unproductive debate might never have arisen (hypothetical result). Imprecise initial framing often generates decades of unnecessary controversy.
quests.textToSpeak: Had the conceptual framework been more precisely specified from the outset, this protracted and unproductive debate might never have arisen.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: Subordinate phrase 'To the extent that' qualifies the success of a naturalistic theory.
quests.explanation: To the extent that any account of causation can be fully naturalistic (qualifying phrase) + this remains among the most rigorously developed attempts (main clause). 'Naturalistic' here means explained without appeal to anything beyond the physical world.
quests.textToSpeak: To the extent that any account of causation can be fully naturalistic, this remains among the most rigorously developed attempts.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: Inverted concessive clause 'defensible though it may be in the abstract'.
quests.explanation: Subject (The position) + defensible though it may be in the abstract (inverted concessive clause) + faces serious practical difficulties once applied to actual cases (main verb). Theoretical defensibility does not guarantee practical applicability.
quests.textToSpeak: The position, defensible though it may be in the abstract, faces serious practical difficulties once applied to actual cases.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: Formal inverted conditional with sweeping epistemological consequences.
quests.explanation: Were the skeptic's argument sound (formal inverted conditional) + virtually nothing we ordinarily claim to know would survive its corrosive implications (hypothetical result). 'Corrosive' is metaphorical, suggesting the argument gradually destroys claims to knowledge.
quests.textToSpeak: Were the skeptic's argument sound, virtually nothing we ordinarily claim to know would survive its corrosive implications.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: Formal subordinate phrase 'Notwithstanding' contrasts elegance with a foundational weakness.
quests.explanation: Notwithstanding its formal elegance (formal contrast phrase) + the proof relies on an inference rule whose validity remains genuinely contested (main clause). Formal beauty does not guarantee that every underlying assumption is sound.
quests.textToSpeak: Notwithstanding its formal elegance, the proof relies on an inference rule whose validity remains genuinely contested.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: Fronted phrase 'Far from being' contrasts perceived irrelevance with practical importance.
quests.explanation: Far from being merely academic (fronted contrast phrase) + this debate over moral realism carries significant implications for how we justify ethical claims (main clause). 'Moral realism' is the view that objective moral facts genuinely exist.
quests.textToSpeak: Far from being merely academic, this debate over moral realism carries significant implications for how we justify ethical claims.

quests.instruction: Listen to the audio and arrange the words in the correct order.
quests.hint: Subordinate clause 'Much as' introduces a trade-off between unification and specificity.
quests.explanation: Much as the framework succeeds in unifying disparate phenomena (concession) + it does so at the cost of considerable explanatory specificity (critique). This reflects a common trade-off between theoretical breadth and explanatory precision.
quests.textToSpeak: Much as the framework succeeds in unifying disparate phenomena, it does so at the cost of considerable explanatory specificity.
